note: 路人（非族人的遊客）與小孩的閒聊。路人只講自己的旅行與禮貌，不替族人說明文化。

greet.en: Hi! Are you here on holiday too?

lines.zh: 民宿老闆說，灘頭上的船不能碰，我們就遠遠拍。
lines.en: The guesthouse owner said not to touch the boats on the beach, so we take photos from far away.

lines.zh: 東清灣的海好藍，看多久都不膩。
lines.en: The sea at Dongqing Bay is so blue. I could look at it all day.

lines.zh: 晚上的星星好多，城市裡根本看不到。
lines.en: So many stars at night. You never see this in the city.

lines.zh: 導遊說進部落要放低音量，拍人之前要先問。
lines.en: Our guide said to keep our voices down in the villages, and to ask before taking photos of people.

lines.zh: 等一下要去買紀念品，你知道哪裡有雜貨店嗎？
lines.en: We're going to buy souvenirs later. Do you know where a grocery store is?

lines.zh: 跟團跑了一整天，腳好痠。
lines.en: A whole day on the tour. My feet are so sore.

lines.zh: 退休了，終於有時間慢慢走。這裡的路沿著海，走起來很舒服。
lines.en: I'm retired, so I finally have time to walk slowly. The road follows the sea. It's lovely to walk.

lines.zh: 我們不趕行程，看到什麼就停下來看。
lines.en: We're not in a hurry. We stop whenever we see something.

lines.zh: 早點休息，明天想去看日出。
lines.en: Early night for me. I want to see the sunrise tomorrow.

lines.zh: 我在學中文，也在學一點點族語的問候。
lines.en: I'm learning Chinese, and a few Tao greetings too.

lines.zh: 我把垃圾都帶走，島上的垃圾很難處理。
lines.en: I take all my rubbish with me. Rubbish is hard to deal with on an island.

lines.zh: 今天走了好遠，明天再去另一邊。
lines.en: I walked so far today. I'll try the other side tomorrow.

lines.zh: 孩子第一次來蘭嶼，一直問東問西。
lines.en: It's the kids' first time on Lanyu. They ask about everything.

lines.zh: 防曬、帽子、水都帶了，海邊太陽很大。
lines.en: Sunscreen, hats, water — we brought it all. The sun is strong by the sea.

lines.zh: 孩子玩累了，今天會很好睡。
lines.en: The kids are worn out. They'll sleep well tonight.

lines.zh: 媽媽說海邊的東西只能看，不能帶回家。
lines.en: Mum says the things on the beach are only for looking. We can't take them home.

lines.zh: 放學以後我都在這裡踢球。
lines.en: I play football here every day after school.

lines.zh: 球不要踢到人家的田裡，阿嬤會生氣。
lines.en: Don't kick the ball into anyone's field. Grandma will get angry.

lines.zh: 天黑了，我要回家吃飯了。
lines.en: It's dark. I'm going home for dinner.

lines.zh: 我的望遠鏡可以看好遠喔！
lines.en: My binoculars can see really far!

KD1.zh: 我回去跟爸爸媽媽說了：拼板舟要遠遠看，不能摸。
KD1.en: I told Mum and Dad: look at the plank boats from far away, don't touch.

lines.zh: 我喜歡畫海邊的東西，貝殼、螃蟹、石頭都畫。
lines.en: I like drawing things from the beach — shells, crabs, stones.

KD2.zh: 寄居蟹的畫我會帶去學校給老師看。
KD2.en: I'll take my hermit crab drawing to school to show my teacher.
